description: Defines the Starboard Event system, including event types, data structures, callback types, and functions for event handling, scheduling, and lifecycle management within the Starboard platform.

methods.name: SbEventIsIdValid
methods.description: Checks if the given event ID is valid (not equal to kSbEventIdInvalid).

methods.name: SbRunStarboardMain
methods.description: Entry point to run the Starboard main loop with the application's event handler callback.

methods.name: SbEventHandle
methods.description: Main handler for processing incoming Starboard events; must copy data to extend its lifetime.

methods.name: SbEventSchedule
methods.description: Schedules a callback to be invoked in the main Starboard event loop after an optional delay.

methods.name: SbEventCancel
methods.description: Cancels a scheduled event by its ID if it has not yet fired.
